note: NBSP is a CKEditor 5 plugin (toolbar item id 'nbsp', label 'Non-breaking space', shortcut Ctrl+Space, ckeditor5 plugin nbsp.Nbsp, inserts a <nbsp> element) plus a text-format filter NbspCleanerFilter (id nbsp_cleaner_filter, title 'Cleanup NBSP markup') that converts <nbsp> and legacy <span class="nbsp"> to a real UTF-8 non-breaking space. It has no settings page, no configure route, no permissions, no Drush, no config schema of its own. All state lives in the standard config entities editor.editor.<format> (settings.toolbar.items) and filter.format.<format> (filters.nbsp_cleaner_filter). Requires core editor + ckeditor5. medium/hard cases create namespaced text formats/editors (nbsp_*) and read/write those config entities; cleanup deletes them.

evals.prompt: I installed the nbsp Drupal module. How do I actually enable non-breaking-space support for a specific text format / CKEditor 5 editor?
evals.expected_output: On the text format (/admin/config/content/formats/manage/<format>): drag the NBSP button into the active CKEditor 5 toolbar, enable the 'Cleanup NBSP markup' filter (nbsp_cleaner_filter), and if 'Limit allowed HTML tags' is on add <nbsp> to the allowed tags.

evals.prompt: In the nbsp module, what is the machine id and title of the text-format filter it provides, and what does that filter do to the stored markup?
evals.expected_output: The filter is nbsp_cleaner_filter, titled 'Cleanup NBSP markup'. On output it replaces <nbsp></nbsp> tags (and legacy <span class="nbsp">) with a real UTF-8 non-breaking space character.

evals.prompt: With the nbsp module's CKEditor plugin, what keyboard shortcut inserts a non-breaking space, and what is the toolbar button called?
evals.expected_output: Press Ctrl+Space, or use the 'Non-breaking space' toolbar button (toolbar item id nbsp). The inserted character is highlighted in blue in the editor.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, a text format named 'nbsp_eval' has been set up to handle non-breaking spaces from the nbsp module. Inspect the live text-format configuration and name the filter that provides this.
evals.expected_output: The filter is nbsp_cleaner_filter ('Cleanup NBSP markup'), enabled on filter.format.nbsp_eval.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the CKEditor 5 editor for the text format 'nbsp_tbfmt' has the non-breaking-space button on its toolbar. Inspect the live editor configuration and give the toolbar item id used for that button.
evals.expected_output: The toolbar item id is 'nbsp', present in editor.editor.nbsp_tbfmt settings.toolbar.items.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format with machine name 'nbsp_task' that does not yet clean up non-breaking-space markup. Using the nbsp module, enable its cleanup filter on that text format. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the nbsp_cleaner_filter filter (status TRUE) on filter.format.nbsp_task (e.g. FilterFormat::load('nbsp_task')->setFilterConfig('nbsp_cleaner_filter', ['status' => TRUE])->save()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the text format 'nbsp_tb' uses CKEditor 5 but its toolbar does not have the non-breaking-space button. Using the nbsp module, add the NBSP button to that editor's toolbar. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Append 'nbsp' to editor.editor.nbsp_tb settings.toolbar.items (the CKEditor 5 active toolbar) and save.
